title: NGO Oversight, Civic Audit, and Democratic Renewal

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Many civil society organisations (*civil szervezetek*) see themselves as watchdogs. They run databases on public procurement (*közbeszerzések*), asset declarations and court rulings, and use them to monitor public officials.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The ideal of public service (*közszolgálat*) is, in the classic view, an ethical one: public servants are expected to act impartially (*pártatlanság*) and to serve the public interest (*közérdek*).

sections.title: Patterns in Context
